description: The M240 turret bones name parents swing_2 and swing_3, which the skeleton does not have. Arma logs 'Invalid parent bone' and already treats them as root bones; an empty parent says so explicitly. The left M134's muzzle_3 shares a memory vertex with the wlight_full bone, which collapses it to the model origin, so the gun fired from the middle of the boat; it gets its own vertex at the authored spot, bound like chamber_3.
